versions.content: The function Fee_InvalidateBlock shall check if the module state is MEMIF_IDLE or MEMIF_BUSY_INTERNAL. If this is the case the module shall accept the invalidation request and shall return E_OK to the caller. The block invalidation shall be executed asynchronously in the module's main function as soon as the module has finished the internal management operation.
